name: budget
title: Project overall and annual budgets
description: Project overall and annual budgets. Separate original budget, supplements, returns, releases and transfers by verified value type and transaction semantics; do not sum all BPGE/BPJA rows as available budget. Currency, object ownership, fiscal year and availability-control settings must be enriched and approved. Reconcile overall and annual budget separately through a supported budget interface.
tested_release: none (draft, ECC 6.0 on NetWeaver 7.40 SP08 assumed)
